name: Lone Duelist (Combat)
body:
You are adept at fending off multiple foes at once.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, 2nd-level duelist

Benefit: Whenever you are being threatened in melee by more than one opponent, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to armor class and CMD for each opponent beyond the first, up to +1 per two levels of duelist you possess. A condition that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to armor class also makes you lose the benefits of this feat.
